title: Redirect via redirect_to (ruby) — review required
description: The ruby call redirect_to redirects the user to a computed address. If the address derives from untrusted input, phishing links gain the site's credibility. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the target is fixed or validated.
remediation: Redirect only to fixed paths or validate the target with an allowlist of paths before redirecting.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any redirect_to call matches, including fixed-target redirects.
